response.sql: WITH site_stats AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat HAVING AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) IS NOT NULL), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS status_ratio FROM site_stats GROUP BY insurstat), kept AS (SELECT ss.insurstat, ss.site_ratio, ss.mesh_count, sa.status_ratio FROM site_stats ss JOIN status_avg sa ON sa.insurstat = ss.insurstat WHERE ss.site_ratio > sa.status_ratio) SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(mesh_count) AS total_mesh_records, AVG(site_ratio - status_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status FROM kept GROUP BY insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: A site's number of mesh records counts all scanmesh rows linked to the site, including rows whose ratio is missing. The request does not say whether it means all records or only those with a usable ratio.
A per-record ratio is facetresmm / geomdeltamm. It is treated as missing when either value is NULL or geomdeltamm is 0, since division by zero is undefined.
Sites with a NULL insurstat are excluded. Sites with no computable ratio are excluded, because they cannot be compared to a status average.

alternatives.interpretation: The site's number of mesh records counts only the mesh records that have a computable ratio, so the count matches the records that contribute to the average.
